translations.u131: Registered Users have the right, but not the obligation, to propose the sale of Vehicles. Offers to Sell can be placed independently by the Seller on the Marketplace using the tools and channels made available by Fleequid, or outside the Marketplace using any of the tools and channels made available or otherwise accepted by Fleequid, or with the assistance of Fleequid itself. The Offer to Sell may be made by any means capable of unequivocally expressing the intention to sell and must allow the Vehicles to be identified, including by VIN or equivalent data, and the MCSP to be indicated. By the Offer to Sell the Seller assumes the obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, binds itself to the financial parameters indicated and accepts that Fleequid shall structure, at its sole discretion, the specific transaction according to one of the Sales Models, in accordance with Arts. 3 and 8.6. The Offer to Sell is valid and effective and binds the Seller from the moment it is made or confirmed, even where the Listing has not yet been published or the technical dossier has not yet been prepared.
translations.u132: Following the Offer to Sell received, which is already valid and effective pursuant to these GTC, for the purposes of the Listing and the start of the Sales Event, Fleequid requires the Seller to provide a truthful description in good faith of the Vehicle's Technical Specifications. The Seller is required to provide all technical and administrative information relating to the Vehicle accurately and completely, together with real photographic images. The description of the Vehicle and the images or other content uploaded may not include any links external to the Marketplace, phone numbers or e-mail addresses. Fleequid reserves the right to anonymise images or documents that may allow the current or previous owners of the Vehicle to be identified. Users acknowledge and agree that Fleequid may, until the Binding Agreement is concluded and within the limits provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, reject an Offer to Sell, an attempted purchase, a Bid or an acceptance without any obligation to specify the reasons, and assign a Vehicle to a category or product group other than that indicated by the Seller. Where time limits or deadlines are set, the date and time recorded by Fleequid's computer systems shall be decisive. In order to facilitate the marketing of the Vehicles, Fleequid may offer the Seller, where available, the preparation of a technical dossier or of a TrustReport; the performance of such activities, even when requested by the Seller, is subject to Fleequid's approval and to any applicable Fees. When such Services are made available, the Seller undertakes to make available to the appointed Fleequid personnel the Vehicles and the related administrative and technical documentation, and to provide, through its own technicians, assistance during the inspection process. The Seller also authorises Fleequid to view, test and photograph the Vehicles and to carry out the inspections necessary for the purposes of marketing them. If requested and subject to approval, Fleequid may also manage Vehicle logistics, conduct administrative investigations or gather additional technical documentation, subject to availability and to any Fees provided for. The technical dossier prepared by Fleequid must be examined and confirmed by the Seller, who is required to report promptly any deficiencies or inaccuracies. It is the Seller's sole responsibility to verify that the technical dossier made available for consultation with the Listing corresponds to the actual Technical Specifications of the Vehicle. The publication of the technical dossier on the Marketplace, in the absence of prompt reporting by the Seller of any errors or inaccuracies, constitutes tacit approval of the dossier by the Seller, save in cases of wilful misconduct. The provisions of this paragraph relating to verification, approval and the Seller's liability apply, in so far as compatible, to the entire Listing, including where it is prepared by Fleequid on behalf of the Seller on the basis of the information provided by the latter or otherwise available to it. The preparation by Fleequid of the technical dossier, the TrustReport or other verification or inspection activities does not release the Seller from liability for the truthfulness, completeness and correctness of the information and documentation relating to the Vehicle, in accordance with Arts. 8.13 and 19.6.
translations.u133: In submitting the Offer to Sell and in connection with the subsequent marketing, the Seller represents and warrants to Fleequid and to the Bidders that the Vehicle is currently, and shall be at the date of transfer of ownership, fully owned by the Seller and free from any Encumbrances. Exceptionally, Fleequid may authorise the marketing of Vehicles subject to Encumbrances, provided that the Seller declares their existence in the Offer to Sell itself and notifies Fleequid promptly and in writing of their nature, their extent, the procedures necessary for their removal and the related costs. Unless otherwise agreed in writing or otherwise provided in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, the removal of Encumbrances shall be at the Seller's sole cost and expense and must be completed within 3 (three) days of Fleequid's request and, in any event, before the transfer of ownership of the Vehicle. Failure to remove the Encumbrances within the aforesaid time limit entitles Fleequid to terminate the Contract concerned pursuant to Art. 17.8 or, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, Art. 17.14, and to charge the Seller a penalty of €2,000.00 (EUR two thousand/00) for each Vehicle affected by the Encumbrance, regardless of the number of Encumbrances affecting the same Vehicle, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where the Offer to Sell concerns Vehicles intended exclusively for scrapping or otherwise qualifying as ELVs, the Seller shall immediately inform Fleequid thereof, provide all information and documentation necessary to verify their classification, origin and lawful possession and ensure compliance, in so far as this falls within its responsibility, with the applicable environmental obligations, so that Fleequid may restrict participation in the relevant Sales Event to only those Users holding the professional requirements prescribed by the applicable legislation and adopt the further measures provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including with regard to the Sales Model and the method of performance that may be used. The rules governing the performance phase for Vehicles qualifying as ELVs are contained in Art. 16.13.
translations.u134: Where the Offer to Sell, or the information, data or content relating to the Listing, is incomplete, inaccurate or out of date, or otherwise requires supplementing or correcting, Fleequid has the right to request from the Seller at any time the necessary information and documents, including after acceptance of the Offer to Sell and after the preparation and publication of the Listing. The Seller undertakes to provide what is requested within 3 (three) days of the relative request.
translations.u135: The Seller is required to provide Fleequid promptly with, and to keep constantly up to date, its identification, tax and invoicing details, its bank details and any other information necessary for the performance of the transactions and the fulfilment of the obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including those relating to invoicing, to the payment of the sums due to the Seller and, where the Commission Sale is performed with Fleequid acting as a Pure Intermediary, to the communication of the Seller's details to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 11.4. The obligation provided for in this paragraph is general and continuing in nature and remains in force for the entire duration of the relationship and until completion of the transactions in progress. The Seller is liable for the delays, errors and consequences arising from missing, inaccurate, incomplete or out-of-date data, including the resulting delays and costs for Fleequid, for the Buyer or for the performance of the transaction.
translations.u136: Following acceptance of the Offer to Sell, Fleequid determines, as part of the organisation of the process of marketing the Vehicle and in accordance with Art. 3, the Sales Model, the type of Sales Event and the related operating procedures. Where it is appropriate to proceed with one or more subsequent Sales Events relating to the same Vehicle, it is for Fleequid to determine their scheduling, the time interval between them and, within the limits provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, also the possible adoption of a different Sales Model. In the Commission Sale the duration of each Auction, the value of any increments and the Starting Price are established in a reasonable manner by Fleequid; without prejudice to the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions and of any applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions, Fleequid determines at its discretion the type of Sales Event to be used for the attempted sale. Where a Reserve Price is provided for, the Starting Price may be set by Fleequid at a lower, equal or higher amount than the Reserve Price, it being understood that, at the end of the Sales Event, the Binding Agreement is concluded only where the conditions provided for in Art. 10 are met. Where, on the basis of the type of Sales Event chosen, no Reserve Price is provided for, the outcome of the Event results in the conclusion of the Binding Agreement at the price resulting from the process. In Dealer Sales, Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller at the Purchase Price and on the conditions agreed with the latter pursuant to Art. 18.3 and independently determines the methods of the subsequent marketing and resale of the Vehicle, including by means of one or more Sales Events.
translations.u137: By submitting the Offer to Sell, the Seller expressly authorises Fleequid to prepare, publish and advertise, where the Seller has not done so independently, the Listing relating to the Vehicle, and to make the Technical Specifications and the further information relating to the Vehicle available to other Users at any time, both before and during the Sales Event, through the Marketplace or other communication channels, such as, by way of example, advertisements on other websites, newsletters, sections dedicated to upcoming Events and other promotional tools used by Fleequid. The Offer to Sell is considered accepted by Fleequid when the latter confirms its acceptance, including by electronic or analogue means, or in any event performs it by means of activities unequivocally directed at the marketing of the Vehicle, without the preparation or publication of the Listing being necessary for the purposes of the effectiveness or binding nature of the Offer to Sell. The preparation and publication of the Listing are merely acts in performance of the Offer to Sell and may be carried out by Fleequid without the need for further approval. The Seller consents to any visits organised by Fleequid at the place where the Vehicles are kept and undertakes to make available, where necessary, the drivers, technicians and assistance reasonably required to enable Users interested in purchasing to view and test them.
translations.u138: At the moment the Offer to Sell is considered accepted by Fleequid pursuant to Art. 8.7, a marketing relationship in respect of the Vehicle is entered into between the Seller and Fleequid. Under that relationship the Seller irrevocably undertakes, on the terms and for the period provided for in this paragraph, to allow the marketing and sale of the Vehicle through Fleequid; Fleequid is authorised to organise one or more Sales Events, including successive ones, and to identify for each transaction the applicable Sales Model in accordance with Arts. 3 and 8.6. Acceptance of the Offer to Sell does not, in itself, entail the conclusion of a commission contract relating to a specific Sales Event, nor of a sales contract between the Seller and Fleequid, and does not give rise to any obligation on Fleequid to purchase the Vehicle. The relationships and obligations of purchase and transfer relating to the individual transaction arise in accordance with the Sales Model applicable from time to time and on the conditions provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. The conclusion of the Binding Agreement does not, in itself, entail the immediate transfer of ownership of the Vehicle or an obligation on Fleequid to proceed immediately with its purchase from the Seller. In the Commission Sale the Seller remains bound to the sale for the entire duration of the Optioned Status, but the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid for the purposes of the Resale and the subsequent transfer to the Buyer take place exclusively following full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 and the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction; where Fleequid decides, pursuant to Art. 2.6, to perform the transaction as a Pure Intermediary, the transfer of ownership takes place, on the same conditions, directly from the Seller to the Buyer. In the event of non-payment by the Buyer and consequent Cancellation of the Sale, Fleequid is not required to purchase the Vehicle from the Seller. In Dealer Sales in which the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid is linked to its subsequent sale to a specific Buyer, the purchase contract between the Seller and Fleequid is concluded in accordance with Art. 18.2, but its effects and the obligation to perform it remain subject to the condition precedent of full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2; such condition is provided for in the exclusive interest of Fleequid, which may waive it and proceed with the purchase of the Vehicle in any event. The aforesaid condition does not apply where Fleequid purchases the Vehicle irrespective of the prior identification of a specific Buyer pursuant to Art. 18.2. Where the conditions provided for the performance of the specific transaction are met, the Seller is required to transfer the Vehicle to Fleequid or, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, directly to the Buyer. In any event, the accuracy and completeness of the Technical Specifications and of the information contained in the Offer to Sell and in the Listing, and the correctness of the documents provided by the Seller or otherwise associated with the Vehicle, remain essential, including where the technical dossier or the Listing has been prepared by Fleequid or by persons appointed by it. The Seller acknowledges and accepts that any invoicing request made by Fleequid is of an administrative nature and does not, in itself, constitute confirmation that the conditions provided for in these General Terms and Conditions for the performance of the sale have been fulfilled. The Seller further acknowledges Fleequid's right to proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale or to terminate the Contract in the cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including as a consequence of delay or non-payment by the Buyer, waiving any claim against Fleequid in relation to the effects deriving from the legitimate exercise of such rights. The marketing and sale commitment undertaken by the Seller is of indefinite duration, with a minimum period of 60 (sixty) days starting from the date on which the Offer to Sell is considered accepted pursuant to Art. 8.7; during such period the Seller may not revoke the mandate granted to Fleequid. Upon expiry of the minimum period, the Seller may withdraw by giving Fleequid at least 15 (fifteen) days' prior written notice. The withdrawal becomes effective: (i) upon expiry of the notice period, if the Vehicle is not the subject of a Sales Event in progress; (ii) upon conclusion of the Sales Event, if at the end of the notice period the Vehicle is still included in it and no Binding Agreement has been concluded. Where a Binding Agreement is concluded, the Seller's commitment continues for the entire duration of the Optioned Status and, in any event, for the time necessary to perform the obligations arising from the transaction, without prejudice, once the transaction has been performed, to the obligations necessary for its completion. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale, Fleequid also retains, for the 30 (thirty) days following notification of the Cancellation of the Sale, the right to market the Vehicle again, without prejudice to Arts. 3, 8.6 and 10.5.
translations.u139: After acceptance of the Offer to Sell, the Seller acknowledges and accepts that Fleequid has exclusivity in the promotion and marketing of the Vehicle for the entire duration of the commitment undertaken pursuant to Art. 8.8. During such period the Seller may not offer, promote or sell the Vehicle through channels other than those managed or used by Fleequid, save with the latter's prior written authorisation. The exclusivity continues, in particular, during the Sales Events and, once the Binding Agreement has been concluded, for as long as the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status, including any period of delay in payment, without being interrupted by the expiry of the Payment Period. It ceases when the Vehicle has been definitively transferred in the context of the transaction, when the marketing commitment pursuant to Art. 8.8 has ended, or when Fleequid notifies the Seller in writing that it no longer has any interest in marketing the Vehicle. The Seller undertakes not to interfere with the marketing process and to refer to Fleequid any requests for information or purchase requests received from persons interested in the Vehicle during the exclusivity period, promptly informing Fleequid of any purchase requests received directly. In the event of breach of the obligations provided for in this paragraph, Fleequid is entitled to charge the Seller a penalty equal to three times the Commissions that would have been due from the Seller had the Vehicle been sold under the Commission Sale, taking as reference the Reserve Price determined on the basis of the MCSP indicated in the first Offer to Sell relating to the Vehicle and the applicable Fleequid Fee Schedule in force at the start of the marketing of the Vehicle through Fleequid, subsequent amendments to which do not affect the quantification of the penalty, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. The same criterion for determining the penalty also applies where the specific transaction is structured as Dealer Sales, in which case the reference to the Commissions is relevant exclusively as an agreed parameter for quantifying the penalty and does not entail the application to the Seller of the Commissions provided for the Commission Sale.
translations.u140: Where a Sales Event does not result in the conclusion of a Binding Agreement, Fleequid may propose to the Seller, in view of a subsequent sales attempt, the revision of the MCSP or of the other financial terms concerning the relationship with the Seller. Any reduction of the MCSP requires the Seller's express acceptance and takes effect exclusively for transactions subsequent to such acceptance. Where applicable, Fleequid shall accordingly redetermine the Reserve Price or the financial terms of the subsequent purchase of the Vehicle in Dealer Sales. Failing agreement, the previously agreed MCSP remains unchanged. In any event, for the purposes of the penalties referred to in Arts. 8.9, 17.8 and 17.14, the respective criteria for determination provided for in those provisions remain unaffected.
translations.u141: Once the marketing commitment undertaken pursuant to Art. 8.8 has ended, if the Vehicle has not been sold, the Seller may proceed with its sale independently through any other channel, without any minimum price constraint and to any party, without prejudice to any obligations to transfer the Vehicle that have already arisen or are still pending in relation to a specific transaction and, in particular, in the context of Dealer Sales. The Seller remains under the obligation not to use information, contacts or business opportunities acquired through the Marketplace or through Fleequid for the purpose of concluding, directly or indirectly, transactions intended to circumvent Fleequid's involvement. Such obligation continues for 24 (twenty-four) months from the first publication of the Listing relating to the Vehicle on the Marketplace or, where no publication of a Listing is envisaged, from the first marketing activity in respect of the Vehicle carried out by Fleequid. In the event of breach, Fleequid is entitled to charge the Seller the penalty determined in accordance with the criterion provided for in Art. 8.9. Where the Seller, when required to transfer the Vehicle under the applicable Sales Model and these General Terms and Conditions, refuses without justification to transfer ownership thereof: a) to Fleequid, in the context of the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, the Seller shall pay the latter a penalty equal to 30% of the Sale Price to the Buyer; b) to Fleequid, in the context of Dealer Sales, the Seller shall pay the latter a penalty equal to 30% of the Purchase Price due from Fleequid to the Seller; c) directly to the Buyer, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary pursuant to Art. 2.6, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty equal to 30% of the Sale Price to the Buyer. For the purposes of this paragraph, refusal is deemed to have occurred when it is evidenced by a statement by the Seller or by conduct on its part unequivocally incompatible with performance or, failing that, when the Seller fails to perform the specific obligation within 10 (ten) days of the written formal notice by which Fleequid has called upon it to perform. This is without prejudice to Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage and, where the Sales Contract is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer, to any right and remedy available to the latter. In Dealer Sales the further damage recoverable by Fleequid also includes the amounts that it is required to pay to its own Buyer as a consequence of the Seller's breach, as well as the related refunds, penalties, costs and expenses. The further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions also remain unaffected, including those referred to in Arts. 16.9 and 17.8 and, where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, in Art. 17.14, subject to the coordination of the related penalties in accordance with Art. 15.8. In particular, where the sale of the Vehicle to third parties or other equivalent conduct engaged in during Optioned Status simultaneously constitutes the breach of exclusivity referred to in Art. 8.9, the refusal to transfer ownership governed by this paragraph or the failure to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it referred to in Art. 16.9, the related penalties are not cumulative when they arise from the same underlying fact and protect the same interest: one penalty only applies, identified, in application of the criterion referred to in Art. 15.8, in the following order: (i) the penalty provided for in this paragraph, where the conduct constitutes refusal to transfer ownership according to the criteria indicated above; (ii) failing refusal, the penalties provided for in Art. 16.9, where the conduct results in the failure to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it, followed by the Cancellation of the Sale; (iii) in other cases, the penalty provided for in Art. 8.9 for breach of exclusivity; without prejudice to consequences that are not in the nature of a penalty and to those arising from materially distinct facts.
translations.u142: The Vehicle remains under the control and in the custody of the Seller until such time as, depending on the applicable Sales Model and the method of performance of the specific transaction, ownership of it must be transferred or it must be delivered to Fleequid or to the Buyer. For the entire duration of the marketing relationship and, once the Binding Agreement has been concluded, for as long as the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and until delivery, the Seller undertakes to keep the Vehicle in its custody with due diligence, to keep it compliant with the description, with the documentation made available and with the Technical Specifications, not to use it and to refrain from any conduct capable of altering its condition, save in the case, governed by Art. 13, in which it is expressly agreed that the Vehicle shall temporarily remain in use by the Seller. The Seller shall refrain, in particular, from removing components or accessories, from replacing them with deteriorated or lower-quality parts and from any other conduct in bad faith capable of compromising the value, functionality, condition or marketability of the Vehicle. In the event of breach of the obligations provided for in this paragraph, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €3,000.00 (EUR three thousand/00) for each Vehicle concerned, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage and to the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. The provisions of Art. 8.14 on the preparation of the Vehicle for delivery and its fitness to be moved, with the related penalty, and those of Art. 16.8 on the ascertainment of unfitness at the time of collection remain unaffected. The obligations and the penalty provided for in this paragraph continue to apply even after the transfer of ownership of the Vehicle to Fleequid, including a purchase for stock in Dealer Sales, for as long as the Vehicle physically remains with the Seller or otherwise at its disposal; in respect of the same underlying fact and for the protection of the same interest, the penalty provided for in this paragraph prevails over the residual penalty provided for in Art. 17.8, including where applicable pursuant to Art. 18.5.
translations.u143: The Seller agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Fleequid, its subsidiaries, associated or affiliated companies, and their respective directors, shareholders, employees, collaborators, agents and representatives, against any claim, demand, suit, action, controversy, damages, costs, expenses or charges of any kind arising from: a) falsity, omissions, inaccuracies or breaches relating to the representations, warranties and undertakings given by the Seller under these General Terms and Conditions, including, by way of example and not limited to, omissions or inaccuracies in the Technical Specifications or in the information relating to the condition, characteristics and operation of the Vehicle, such as the presence of undeclared rust, malfunctioning of the air conditioning system, missing parts or accessories, fault or warning lights being on and similar cases; The examples given in letter a) are purely illustrative and in no way limit the general scope of the indemnity. In Dealer Sales, this indemnity expressly extends to claims brought by the Buyer against Fleequid in its capacity as substantial seller and to all sums, refunds, costs, repair expenses, charges and damages that Fleequid is required to pay or bear vis-à-vis its own Buyer for acts, faults, defects, omissions or breaches attributable to the Seller; in such cases Fleequid has a right of recourse against the Seller and is entitled to full reimbursement of the amounts paid or borne. The Seller is required to check the information made available and to report promptly to Fleequid any inaccuracy, as well as to disclose, before the transfer of the Vehicle, any fault, defect, accident, modification, failure or anomaly of which it is aware. Save in the case of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid, the latter is not liable for the consequences arising from inaccuracies, incompleteness or discrepancies in the information relating to the Vehicle attributable to the Seller, nor for delays in updating the Offer to Sell, the Listing, the technical dossier or the other information made available to Users where such delays are due to circumstances not attributable to Fleequid. Furthermore, Fleequid does not guarantee the revenues that may be achieved through the marketing or sale of the Vehicle.
translations.u144: The Seller is required to prepare the Vehicle in a reasonable condition for delivery and collection and, save for Vehicles expressly indicated in the Offer to Sell or in the Listing as non-running, intended for scrapping or otherwise subject to special conditions incompatible with ordinary movement, to ensure that the Vehicle is fit to be moved and transferred and has the elements indispensable for that purpose, including, in so far as applicable, minimum fluid levels, working starting systems and tyres in a condition fit for movement. Where the Vehicle is not fit to be moved or transferred owing to defects or deficiencies attributable to the Seller — such as, by way of example, lack of essential fluids, a flat battery, failures of the fuel or braking systems or unsuitable tyres — and the Vehicle has not been expressly classified as non-running, intended for scrapping or subject to similar special conditions, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €500.00 (EUR five hundred/00) for each Vehicle, in addition to full reimbursement of any additional cost or expense necessary to make collection and transport possible, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. The ascertainment of unfitness at the time of collection is governed by Art. 16.8. The consequences provided for in this paragraph apply to facts and breaches distinct from those provided for in Art. 8.12 and do not exclude the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions.
translations.u146: The Offers to Sell accepted by Fleequid may be published on the Marketplace by means of a specific Listing and made available for consultation to registered Users, or be used for the organisation of Sales Events in accordance with the further methods provided for in this article. For all Sales Event methods, including those with the Buy Now option and those that do not provide for the publication of a Listing accessible to Users generally, the marketing and sale commitment undertaken by the Seller remains governed solely by Art. 8.8.
translations.u147: The page of the Marketplace dedicated to the Sales Event shall make known to Users, where applicable, the start and end dates of the Event, the Starting Price, the minimum bid increment allowed, the manner in which the Event is conducted, any characteristics that may qualify it for the purposes of the application of specific Special Sale Terms and Conditions, the applicable Commissions and Fees, any Security Deposit required and its amount, as well as the further elements provided for in Art. 3.2. Where the specific transaction does not provide for the publication of a Listing or for the Event to be conducted via the Marketplace, such information is made known to the Bidder through the channel used by Fleequid for the relevant transaction. Users are required to check, before placing a Bid, the conditions applicable to the specific transaction, including any Special Sale Terms and Conditions made available for consultation or referred to in accordance with Art. 4.5, which may provide for methods, conditions, Commissions, Fees, expenses or other charges different from those ordinarily provided for in these General Terms and Conditions.
translations.u148: Users acknowledge and agree that the information relating to a Sales Event made available in the Listing, on the Marketplace or through the other channels used by Fleequid is indicative until the actual start of the Event and may, until that time, be amended or updated by Fleequid in accordance with Art. 4.8. Such information does not constitute a binding offer to enter into a Sales Contract, but represents an invitation to make Bids (invitatio ad offerendum). Fleequid reserves the right to suspend or cancel the Sales Event if it believes that the Marketplace or the other channels used are being used improperly, or that the conduct of one or more Users may improperly alter or influence the conduct or outcome of the Event. The indicative nature provided for in this paragraph does not apply to the elements indicated in Art. 3.2, letters a), b) and c), which bind Fleequid pursuant to Art. 3.3.
translations.u149: Fleequid is entitled to conduct the Sales Events according to the following methods, which may be used, unless otherwise provided in these General Terms and Conditions or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, both in the context of the Commission Sale and in the context of Dealer Sales:
translations.u150: Bidding Auctions. Bidders may place Bids and subsequent raised bids in accordance with the conditions established for the Event. Fleequid may make available automatic increment systems up to a maximum amount pre-determined by the Bidder and may provide for the extension of the duration of the Auction where Bids are placed close to its end.
translations.u151: Buy Now. Fleequid may allow Users, as a stand-alone method or in association with a Bidding Auction, to place a Bid at the immediate purchase price indicated for the Vehicle, without recourse to the incremental bidding system. Where the Buy Now method is associated with an Auction, the placing of the Bid at the price provided for brings to an end the possibility of placing further Bids in the same Auction.
translations.u152: Private Sales. Fleequid may organise Sales Events intended exclusively for one or more Users identified by it and not visible to Marketplace Users generally. Such Events may be made accessible through the personal area of the designated Users, by means of a direct link or through other channels used by Fleequid. The related methods and conditions are made known to the Users concerned before the Bid is placed. In the Commission Sale, where a Reserve Price is provided for and unless otherwise provided in relation to the specific transaction, the Starting Price of the Private Sale corresponds to the Reserve Price.
translations.u153: 1 Euro Auctions. In addition to the other methods provided for in this article, Fleequid may organise particular categories of Auction, including “1 Euro Auctions”, governed by the relevant Special Sale Terms and Conditions, which apply in accordance with Art. 4.5. Such Auctions may provide for the absence of a Reserve Price and for specific methods of determining the price and the other applicable financial elements, including, where provided for by the applicable Sales Model, the Commissions and the Fees. In any event, the Seller remains entitled to obtain the financial result due to it under the applicable Sales Model and the conditions agreed with Fleequid, including, in the Commission Sale, any economic integration mechanism provided for in the relevant Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u154: Negotiation. Fleequid may conduct, via the Marketplace or through the other channels made available or otherwise accepted by Fleequid, a negotiation relating to the sale of the Vehicle, in the course of which Bids and counter-offers may be made. In the Negotiation the mere exchange of offers and counter-offers does not conclude the Binding Agreement. The Binding Agreement is concluded when the Seller accepts the Bidder's Bid or when the Bidder accepts the Seller's counter-offer; in Dealer Sales acceptance is a matter for Fleequid as seller of the Vehicle. The negotiation ends upon expiry of any time limit set by Fleequid and in the other cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions; no obligation arises between the Parties from the ending of the negotiation.
translations.u155: Off-Auction Sale. Fleequid may manage the sale of the Vehicle outside the Auction process, including on the occasion of events, trade fairs, commercial initiatives or negotiations conducted through channels other than the Marketplace. The mechanism of conclusion provided for in letter e) above applies to the Off-Auction Sale, in so far as compatible with the actual organisation of the transaction.
translations.u156: The conclusion of the Binding Agreement in the various Sales Event methods is governed by Art. 10.2. The rules on the Optioned Status, the Proforma and the Payment Period referred to in Art. 11 and those on payment, delay and Cancellation of the Sale referred to in Arts. 12 and 14 are common to all methods.
translations.u157: Unless otherwise provided in these GTC or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, the Auctions organised by Fleequid have a Reserve Price. A Reserve Price may also be provided for in the other types of Sales Event, where compatible with the manner in which they are conducted. In the Commission Sale the Reserve Price is determined by Fleequid on the basis of the MCSP and the Commissions payable by the Seller, so as to ensure the Seller, when it is reached, net proceeds at least equal to the MCSP, save where the Seller expressly accepts otherwise. In Dealer Sales any Reserve Price relates exclusively to the subsequent sale of the Vehicle by Fleequid to the Buyer and is determined independently by Fleequid in the context of its own resale activity; it does not determine the consideration due to the Seller, which consists of the Purchase Price agreed pursuant to Art. 18.3, and does not alter the other financial terms agreed between Fleequid and the Seller. Placing the highest Bid does not, in itself, give the Bidder the right to purchase the Vehicle until the Binding Agreement is concluded pursuant to Art. 10.
translations.u158: Unless expressly indicated otherwise, all amounts listed on the Marketplace, in the Listing or otherwise in the communications relating to the specific transaction are expressed in EUR and are net of VAT, if applicable, as well as of any further tax, administrative or statutory charges payable by the User under the applicable legislation or the conditions of the specific transaction.
translations.u159: Where the immediate purchase price or the published Starting Price results from a manifest clerical error and does not correspond to the price or the Reserve Price correctly applicable to the specific transaction, Fleequid may correct the error before the Bid is placed; where the Binding Agreement has already been concluded on the basis of the incorrect figure, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale in accordance with the general rules set out in Art. 14. This provision applies exclusively to manifest clerical error and does not confer on Fleequid any discretionary power to change the price after the Bid has been placed.

review: u131: Offers to Sell may be placed independently → Offers to Sell can be placed independently — continuità v8 6.1 ('can be placed'), IT invariato
u132: telephone numbers or e-mail addresses → phone numbers or e-mail addresses — continuità v8 6.2 ('phone numbers'), IT invariato

u132: to make available to the personnel appointed by Fleequid the Vehicles and the related administrative and technical documentation, and to provide, through its own appointed technical personnel, assistance → to make available to the appointed Fleequid personnel the Vehicles and the related administrative and technical documentation, and to provide, through its own technicians, assistance — continuità v8 6.2 ('appointed Fleequid personnel', 'through its own technicians'), IT invariato

u132: If requested and approved by Fleequid, the latter may also manage the logistics of the Vehicles, conduct administrative investigations or obtain additional technical documentation, subject to availability and to any applicable Fees. → If requested and subject to approval, Fleequid may also manage Vehicle logistics, conduct administrative investigations or gather additional technical documentation, subject to availability and to any Fees provided for. — continuità v8 6.2 (formula 'If requested and subject to approval, Fleequid may manage Vehicle logistics ... gather'); 'eventuali Tariffe previste' distinto da 'Tariffe applicabili'
u133: and free from any Encumbrance. Exceptionally → and free from any Encumbrances. Exceptionally — continuità v8 6.3 ('free from any Encumbrances')

u133: shall be at the Seller's sole charge and expense and must be completed within 3 (three) days from Fleequid's request → shall be at the Seller's sole cost and expense and must be completed within 3 (three) days of Fleequid's request — 'a esclusivo carico e spese': formula inglese 'sole cost and expense' ('charge and expense' è un calco); 'within N days of' come nella v8

u133: regardless of the number of Encumbrances weighing on the same Vehicle, without prejudice to compensation for any further damages → regardless of the number of Encumbrances affecting the same Vehicle, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage — 'gravanti' = 'affecting' (calco 'weighing on'); 'maggior danno' = 'further damage' (scelta EN armonizzata)

u133: ensure compliance, in so far as it is responsible, with the applicable environmental obligations → ensure compliance, in so far as this falls within its responsibility, with the applicable environmental obligations — 'per quanto di propria competenza': la resa precedente poteva leggersi come 'nella misura in cui ne risponde'
u137: constitute mere activities in performance of the Offer to Sell → are merely acts in performance of the Offer to Sell — 'mere attività esecutive': resa idiomatica, senso invariato

u138: the right to proceed with a new marketing of the Vehicle → the right to market the Vehicle again — 'nuova commercializzazione': 'a new marketing' non è inglese corretto ('marketing' non numerabile)
u139: without prejudice to compensation for any further damages. The same → without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. The same — 'maggior danno' = 'further damage'

u139: relevant exclusively as a conventional parameter for quantifying the penalty → relevant exclusively as an agreed parameter for quantifying the penalty — 'parametro convenzionale' = 'agreed parameter' (mai 'conventional'; come k03/k07)

u141: refuses without justified reason to transfer ownership thereof → refuses without justification to transfer ownership thereof — continuità v8 6.13 ('refuses without justification'), IT invariato ('senza giustificato motivo')

u141: refusal is deemed to have occurred when it results from a statement by the Seller or from conduct on its part unequivocally incompatible with performance → refusal is deemed to have occurred when it is evidenced by a statement by the Seller or by conduct on its part unequivocally incompatible with performance — 'risulti da' = 'is evidenced by' ('results from' indica causa, non prova)
u141: Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damages and, → Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage and, — 'maggior danno' = 'further damage'

u141: In Dealer Sales the further damages recoverable by Fleequid also include the amounts → In Dealer Sales the further damage recoverable by Fleequid also includes the amounts — 'maggior danno' = 'further damage' (singolare, verbo accordato)

u141: or the failure to make available or deliver referred to in Art. 16.9, the related penalties are not cumulative when they arise from the same material fact and protect the same interest → or the failure to make the Vehicle available or to deliver it referred to in Art. 16.9, the related penalties are not cumulative when they arise from the same underlying fact and protect the same interest — 'medesimo fatto materiale' = 'same underlying fact'; 'mancata messa a disposizione o consegna' come nell'art. 16.9 EN (k07)

u142: for the same material fact and in protection of the same interest → in respect of the same underlying fact and for the protection of the same interest — 'medesimo fatto materiale' = 'same underlying fact'; formula identica agli artt. 15.8/17.8 EN
